system.description:
Reduces the intensity of the target's [Fatigue] by -20. The target is immune to [Dazed] or [Staggered] status effects received next. This effect is treated as a Condition, and once it is triggered, it is removed. A magic tablecloth said to be the life's work of a magician known as a gourmet. Spreading it out while picturing a feast makes the imagined dishes appear.
